A3.title: Centrality hub
A3.why: Round 4's A3: the bowl, the node that joins the other two, wears an accent halo broken where its edges leave.

A1+3a.title: Route and hub, both whole
A1+3a.why: A1 and A3 together: the traced route with its stops, and the halo on the bowl. The most literal; the busiest at 16 px.

A1+3b.title: Hub found, no route
A1+3b.why: A3's halo plus A1's stop inside the bowl only: the node the algorithm picked out, ringed and filled. No route line, so the g stays clean.

A1+3c.title: Route into the hub
A1+3c.why: A1's route from the ear node ends at the bowl's centre, which wears A3's halo: a search that reached the central node. One line, one stop, one halo.
